scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @mutiny/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "pnpm --filter @mutiny/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @mutiny/server dev" "pnpm --filter @mutiny/client dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mutiny/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mutiny/shared build && pnpm --filter @mutiny/shared test && pnpm --filter @mutiny/server test && pnpm --filter @mutiny/client test
